review_scope: read-only bounded source review; no service operation executed by this reviewer
stop_test_group: exact unit state inactive/failed+MainPID0 or not-found; observed cgroup trees must have no PIDs before cleanup/restoration
cleanup: exact fresh fixture name, optional persisted ID, labels, configured image and none driver, then stopped-container rm by ID
preservation_scope: all SQLite table row snapshots plus public PG runs/runner_allocations; not all PG tables
finalization: separate phase errors persisted and restoration blocked on uncertain group cleanup/state; restoration only after validation
